answer: Proof of stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to commit verifiable capital. Like a surveyor measuring a deep canyon to build a secure ledge for construction, the protocol stakes value to validate node integrity. An attacker attempting to flood the network with fake identities faces the financial meadow of ruin, as each malicious node demands redundant collateral, making the cost of overwhelming the consensus exponentially prohibitive relative to potential gains.
